paite: Mi tengtengte aw, na khut uh beng unla; nopna aw in Pathian kiang ah kikou un.
heading: Korah Tate La / Vaihawmpa Tungnungpen

paite: TOUPA Tungnungpen akihtakhuai a; leitung tengteng ah kumpipa thupitak ahi.
Ama'n michih i nuai uah azou ding a, i khenuai ah namte azou ding hi.
Ama'n i gouluah ding hon telsak ding a, a-it Jakob leh asuanpen gam mah ahi. Selah
Kikou aw toh Pathian apaitou a, TOUPA pengkul ging toh apaitou hi.
Pathian phat in la sa unla, phat in la sa un; i Kumpipa phat in la sa unla, phat in la sa un.
Pathian lah leitung tengteng Kumpipa ahi ngal a, theisiam a phat in la sa un.
Pathian in namte tung ah vai ahawm a, Pathian alaltutphah siangthou ah atu hi.
Abraham' Pathian mite hi ding in michih lak a miliante a- omkhawm ua, leitung kumpipate Pathian a ahi ngal ua, nakpitak a pahtawi in amah a-om hi.
